Alice Sato: Morning — putting together the RFC review roster for Wednesday 10:00am PT. We have three authors who requested slots: @Ben Keller, @Carmen Li, @Dmitri Ivanov. Can folks confirm reviewer availability and whether we should reorder?
Ben Keller: I can do review slot any time that day except 11–12. Prefer earlier. Will prepare pre-read notes. :+1:
Carmen Li: I prefer to go second so I can address any infra feedback from Ben. Available 9:30–11:30 PT.
Dmitri Ivanov: I asked for a slot because of the routing RFC but I can be flexible — happy to go third. Available 10–12 PT.
Elaine Park: I can review Ben and Carmen. If we need a fourth reviewer for the routing deep-dive (Dmitri) I can join but may have to peekahead.
Alice Sato: Thanks — sounds like ideal ordering is Ben -> Carmen -> Dmitri. That keeps related topics adjacent. Proposed times: 10:00–10:25 Ben, 10:25–10:45 Carmen, 10:45–11:00 Dmitri. Total 60m including 5m buffer. Thoughts?
Ben Keller: That works for me. I'll drop a 1-page pre-read + key questions by EOD tomorrow.
Carmen Li: Fine. I'll upload diagrams to the PR and highlight the migration plan. Requesting @Elaine Park as primary reviewer for my infra items.
Dmitri Ivanov: 10:45 is OK. For routing I need at least one infra person there for kernel tradeoffs — @Elaine Park ok to be primary?
Elaine Park: I can be primary for Carmen and co-review Dmitri. If triage-bot can add a reminder 24h before that'd be great.
triage-bot: Reminder created: "RFC Review — pre-read due" scheduled 24 hours before 1772089856 (Wed 10:00am PT).
Alice Sato: Perfect. Two more logistics items: 1) Please add a single-line TL;DR at the top of each pre-read (what decision you want). 2) If you need >10 minutes for demos, flag it now so we can allocate extra time.
Ben Keller: TL;DR: "Switch default tokenizer to chunked-index tokenizer to reduce cold-start latency; seeking approval to run canary for 2 weeks." No demo.
Carmen Li: TL;DR: "Schema v2: move embeddings vector to separate table to improve join perf; ask to accept migration plan and rollback strategy." Demo will be optional (5m).
Dmitri Ivanov: TL;DR: "Smart routing fallback: add cost-aware fallback tier to reduce failed requests — ask for design signoff." Needs short perf chart (I'll attach).
Alice Sato: Agenda draft (45m):
```
- 5m: Quick context + goals (Alice)
- 20m: Ben (design + canary plan + Q&A)
- 10m: Carmen (migration plan + Q&A)
- 8m: Dmitri (routing fallback + Q&A)
- 2m: Next steps + owners
```
Alice Sato: If anyone needs more than their allotment, call it out now. Also ping reviewers to skim pre-reads before the meeting. I'll publish calendar invites after we confirm ordering. :calendar:
Elaine Park: Can we flip Carmen and Dmitri if Ben needs more time? I can be flexible.
Ben Keller: I might need +5 min depending on Qs. If Carmen goes earlier it's OK.
Alice Sato: Let's keep Ben first; buffer with the 5m and we can borrow from Dmitri's slot if needed. Final checklist: authors attach pre-read w/ TL;DR + key questions, reviewers acknowledge, triage-bot reminder set. I'll send the invite by EOD. :shipit:
